title: S3 sales to dashboard Space
description: Reads one day of sales files from S3, aggregates them into a date-partitioned parquet lake, turns the last 30 days into JSON, fills a prepared dashboard and publishes it as a Space. Nothing new = no publish.

config.code:
# %% settings
# Needs ONE S3 credential set granted to this node (Settings > Credentials > Object storage) with a bucket entry named "raw".
# Input layout: s3://<bucket>/sales/YYYY-MM-DD/*.csv or *.parquet with columns order_id, region, product, amount.
import datetime as dt
import os
from pathlib import Path
day = str(data.get("day") or "").strip() or (dt.date.today() - dt.timedelta(days=1)).isoformat()   # empty (cron) = yesterday
dt.date.fromisoformat(day)                         # stops here on anything that is not YYYY-MM-DD
raw = vault.bucket("raw")
prefix = "sales/%s/" % day
# The parquet lake stays on this machine between runs: ~/.aihub/workingspace/data/sales-lake/date=YYYY-MM-DD/ (same on Windows and Linux).
lake = Path(os.environ.get("SALES_LAKE") or Path.home() / ".aihub" / "workingspace" / "data" / "sales-lake")

# %% extract
import pandas as pd
s3 = raw.boto3()
keys = [o["Key"] for pg in s3.get_paginator("list_objects_v2").paginate(Bucket=raw.bucket, Prefix=prefix) for o in pg.get("Contents", [])]
opts = raw.storage_options()
frames = [pd.read_parquet(raw.uri(k, "s3"), storage_options=opts) if k.endswith(".parquet") else pd.read_csv(raw.uri(k, "s3"), storage_options=opts)
          for k in keys if k.endswith((".parquet", ".csv"))]
log("%d file(s) under s3://%s/%s" % (len(frames), raw.bucket, prefix))

# %% transform
if frames:
    df = pd.concat(frames, ignore_index=True)
    df["amount"] = pd.to_numeric(df["amount"], errors="coerce").fillna(0)
    agg = df.groupby(["region", "product"], as_index=False).agg(orders=("order_id", "nunique"), amount=("amount", "sum"))
else:
    agg = pd.DataFrame(columns=["region", "product", "orders", "amount"])

# %% load
part = lake / ("date=%s" % day)                    # hive partition: the date lives in the folder name
if len(agg):
    part.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    tmp = part / "part-0.parquet.tmp"
    agg.to_parquet(tmp, index=False)
    os.replace(tmp, part / "part-0.parquet")       # a re-run of the same day replaces it
result.update(day=day, rows=int(len(agg)), lake=str(lake), partition=str(part))

# %% read
import datetime as dt
import json
from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd
lake, day = Path(data["lake"]), data["day"]        # from the node "S3 to parquet"
keep = int(data.get("days") or 30)                 # days on the dashboard
df = pd.read_parquet(lake)                         # reads every date=... folder; `date` comes back as a column
df["date"] = df["date"].astype(str)
start = (dt.date.fromisoformat(day) - dt.timedelta(days=keep - 1)).isoformat()
df = df[(df["date"] >= start) & (df["date"] <= day)]

# %% shape
daily = df.groupby("date", as_index=False).agg(orders=("orders", "sum"), amount=("amount", "sum")).sort_values("date")
today = df[df["date"] == day]
doc = {"day": day, "generated": dt.datetime.now().isoformat(timespec="seconds"), "window_days": keep,
       "kpi": {"orders": int(today["orders"].sum()), "amount": round(float(today["amount"].sum()), 2), "regions": int(today["region"].nunique())},
       "daily": daily.round(2).to_dict("records"),
       "by_region": today.groupby("region", as_index=False)["amount"].sum().sort_values("amount", ascending=False).round(2).to_dict("records"),
       "top_products": today.groupby("product", as_index=False)["amount"].sum().nlargest(10, "amount").round(2).to_dict("records")}

# %% write
out = Path(workdir) / "dashboard-data.json"        # the run folder: shows under Files in the run view
out.write_text(json.dumps(doc, indent=1, default=str), encoding="utf-8")
result.update(json_path=str(out), day=day, orders=doc["kpi"]["orders"])

# %% build
# Joins two inputs (through "All of"): data.json_path from "Parquet to JSON" and data.path from "Pre-dashboard" (the template folder).
import json
import shutil
from pathlib import Path
template, doc = Path(data["path"]), json.loads(Path(data["json_path"]).read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
out = Path(workdir) / "dashboard"
shutil.rmtree(out, ignore_errors=True)
shutil.copytree(template, out)                     # never edit the template itself
(out / "data.json").write_text(json.dumps(doc, indent=1), encoding="utf-8")

# %% inline the data into index.html (a Space page needs no fetch)
page = out / "index.html"
html = page.read_text(encoding="utf-8")
tag = '<script id="dash-data" type="application/json">'
i = html.find(tag)
if i < 0:
    raise ValueError('index.html of the template needs a <script id="dash-data" type="application/json"></script> block')
j = html.find("</script>", i)
html = html[:i + len(tag)] + json.dumps(doc).replace("</", "<\\/") + html[j:]
page.write_text(html, encoding="utf-8")
result.update(dashboard=str(out), day=doc["day"])

config.text: No sales files for {{data.day}}: the Space was not updated.

Nodes pass PATHS in data, never the rows: S3 to parquet gives data.lake + data.day, Parquet to JSON gives data.json_path, Pre-dashboard gives data.path, the AND gate merges both, Update gives data.dashboard, which Publish uses. NOT fires when Has new rows stopped; OR picks whichever branch answered. Your own template: in Pre-dashboard type @ and pick your folder from the list; Share copies it into the package so the server gets it too.
